mutations.name: a shadow error is rethrown into the run
kills: marker shadow a shadow failure is sent to the sink and the run completes

mutations.name: the equal-row check is dropped
kills: marker shadow a replayed run appends no second marker

kills: marker shadow a live ci-wait writes one ci:green marker joined to its run id and memo key
